answer_1.quote: MMC-Instruction includes the following tasks: chart information extraction, chart reasoning, scientific chart understanding, chart-to-datatable, and chart-to-json.
answer_1.outputs: Free-form textual answers, structured JSON, data tables, multiple‑choice selections

answer_2.quote: We calculate the accuracy of the model predictions in the MQA setting. There is no need to call GPT-4 for this evaluation. We adopt micro‑averaged accuracy as the evaluation metric ... GPT-4 assisted evaluation can achieve 0.90 agreement (Cohen's kappa agreement) with human evaluation.

answer_3.quote: Generation Ability Evaluation utilizes GPT-4 to assess the accuracy of prediction given question and reference answers ...
methods: Generation Ability Evaluation using GPT-4 scoring

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 500 instances and ask expert annotators to determine whether the output answers from GPT-4 are correct ... We randomly select 300 samples from our testing set and manually evaluate the model predictions.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judge whether model outputs are correct with respect to the chart and instruction.
